summary: The four Rust modules implement a sound DAG scheduling model with good separation of concerns. Core structures (PItem, DagPlan, Task) correctly support all four methodology pillars: (1) Registry via acceptance/artifacts/touches; (2) Traceability via FailReason/inbox_materials/timestamps; (3) Append-only ledger via artifact kinds and skip reasons (NEEDS: auditable skip decision logging); (4) Adversarial audit via acceptance criteria, human_gate, and status machine. Non-essential code (git_* wrappers, slugify) should be cut per hard constraint. propagate_skip needs transformation to emit audit entries.

components.name: PItem struct core fields
components.purpose: Central DAG node: id, desc, depends_on, resources, touches, estimate_secs; execution lifecycle (status, agent_session_id, started_at, completed_at, output_summary)
components.rationale: Essential for all four methodology pillars: (1) REQ registry via desc+touches; (2) traceability via agent_session_id+output_summary; (3) artifacts field stores evidence; (4) human_gate+acceptance enable auditor inspection. Cannot simplify without losing auditability.

components.name: PItem.acceptance (AcceptanceCriterion enum)
components.purpose: Declares verifiable assertions before Done: Builds, TestsPass, HumanReview, Custom
components.rationale: Direct enabler of pillar (4) independent auditor. Each criterion is an assertion to verify. HumanReview bridges human gate. Custom allows methodology-specific criteria (e.g. 'REQ-042 verified'). Underutilized but foundational.

components.name: PItem.artifacts (ArtifactKind enum)
components.purpose: Artifact categories produced by execution: FileList, GitDiff, TestOutput, ManualNote
components.rationale: Maps to pillar (3) append-only ledger. Artifacts are evidence trail: FileList+GitDiff capture changes, TestOutput captures assertions, ManualNote captures human decisions. Defined at P-item but not enforced/tracked—needs worker compliance check.

components.name: PItem.skippable (SkipCondition enum)
components.purpose: When to skip: NoChangesIn(paths) or Custom(reason)
components.rationale: Pillar (3): skip decisions must be logged. NoChangesIn is common (no diff=no work). Custom enables arbitrary declarations. Currently passive; should emit audit log when fired.

components.name: PItem.human_gate boolean field
components.purpose: If true, pause at WaitHumanGate status after worker completion for manual approval
components.rationale: Bridges human judgment into audit chain. Gates mark decision points where human/auditor must sign off. Enables pillar (4). Simple, correct state machine (WaitHumanGate status). No simplification.

components.name: PItemStatus enum and state machine
components.purpose: Lifecycle: WaitDeps → WaitResource → Running → WaitHumanGate → Done/Failed/Skipped. Predicates: is_terminal, unblocks_downstream, is_active
components.rationale: Clean state machine for traceability (pillar 2) and audit (pillar 4). FailReason enum captures causality. Predicates enable scheduler determinism. unblocks_downstream correctly treats Skipped as unblocking (not poisoning per PRD §6.1). Minimal, correct.

components.name: FailReason enum with causality variants
components.purpose: Failure classification: BuildFailed, TestsFailed, AcceptanceRejected, UpstreamFailed, UserRejected, Aborted, Custom
components.rationale: Each variant maps to distinct audit concern (pillars 2 & 4). Enables auditor to filter and root-cause. Custom allows methodology-specific failure types. Essential for diagnosis.

components.name: DagPlan container and accessors
components.purpose: HashMap<PItemId, PItem> with get/get_mut/len; deterministic node_ids()
components.rationale: Minimal, correct. Deterministic ordering aids audit log reproducibility. Serde roundtrip enables persistence. No business logic. No simplification possible.

components.name: DagPlan.validate() integrity check
components.purpose: Verify reference integrity and acyclicity before execution
components.rationale: First gate in traceability chain (pillar 2): validates REQ registry structure. Catches broken references early. Acyclicity prevents infinite loops. Essential pre-flight check.

components.name: DagPlan.unblocked_items() scheduler candidate
components.purpose: Return P-items in WaitDeps whose dependencies are all settled (Done or Skipped)
components.rationale: Core scheduler primitive. Correctly treats Skipped as unblocking. Deterministic sorted output. Essential for DAG parallelism. Single responsibility, well-tested.

components.name: DagPlan.resource_conflicts() contention detection
components.purpose: Find all P-item pairs contending for same resource; emitted once with deterministic ordering
components.rationale: Prevents race conditions on shared resources (build, ports, git locks). Deterministic ordering ensures reproducible audit logs. Supports pillar (1) REQ scoping (which agent can access what). No false conflicts.

components.name: DagPlan.propagate_skip() failure poisoning
components.purpose: Transitively skip descendants of Failed nodes; Skipped/Done unblock, not poison. Return newly-skipped IDs.
components.rationale: Logic correct (Failed poisons per PRD §6.1) BUT: returns IDs without evidence. Pillar (3) requires each skip to emit audit entry with reason/who/when. Recommend: add skip_reason field to track decision, emit audit log when firing. Missing auditability.

components.name: ResourceConflict data record
components.purpose: Immutable record of two P-items contending for a resource
components.rationale: Pure data for scheduler and audit logging. Minimal, correct. No side effects.

components.name: PlanValidationError discriminated union
components.purpose: MissingDep and Cycle errors; includes witness path/reference for diagnosis
components.rationale: Precise error types help auditor diagnose plan integrity. MissingDep includes which ref is broken. Cycle includes witness path. Good for current needs.

components.name: dag.rs topo_sort generic algorithm
components.purpose: Kahn's algorithm for topological sort over arbitrary node type N; returns witness on cycle
components.rationale: Reusable, well-tested standard algorithm. Linear time. No coupling to PItem. Excellent API design (closure-based deps_of). Tests comprehensive (linear, fan-in/out, cycles, unknown deps). Keep as-is.

components.name: dag.rs find_cycle DFS-based detection
components.purpose: DFS cycle detection; returns witness path with closing node appended
components.rationale: Returns auditable witness (not just boolean). Generic, reusable. Tests verify self-loops and simple cycles. Correct implementation.

components.name: dag.rs has_cycle convenience predicate
components.purpose: Boolean wrapper over find_cycle for callers that don't need witness
components.rationale: Minimal helper, zero overhead. Improves readability. One-liner. No reason to cut.

components.name: Task struct and full lifecycle container
components.purpose: Run-level container: id, project_id, title, description, inbox_materials, plan, status, timestamps, master_session_id, workspace, title_auto
components.rationale: Correct three-level hierarchy (Project → Task → P-item per PRD). inbox_materials enable traceability (pillar 2). workspace field supports reproducibility. agent_session_id links to master trace. No bloat, well-scoped.

components.name: TaskStatus enum lifecycle
components.purpose: Drafting → Planning → Ready → Running → Paused → Done/Abandoned
components.rationale: Correct progression. Paused and Abandoned kept briefly for audit (not auto-deleted). Clear states, no dead paths. Tests verify semantics.

components.name: Material + MediaKind inbox types
components.purpose: Inbox materials (File or Text) with MediaKind (Document/Image/Screenshot/Other) and added_at timestamp
components.rationale: Pillar (2) evidence chain. added_at timestamp crucial for audit timeline. Absolute path (fleet-managed) prevents confusion. MediaKind helps auditor understand input type. Sound design.

components.name: TaskEvent SSE protocol
components.purpose: Event stream for live UI: TaskStatusChanged, PItemStatusChanged, PlanUpdated, MaterialAdded, MasterMessage(Event/User/Master)
components.rationale: UX enabler. MasterMessage source triaging (Event/User/Master) is useful for audit—shows who said what. Enables live audit visibility. SSE pattern correct for web clients.

components.name: Task.is_plan_finished predicate

components.purpose: Update title atomically; when auto=true, only writes if title_auto is true (prevents race with user edits); when false, clears title_auto

components.name: get_task read operation
components.purpose: Read single task JSON by id; error if not found or parse fails
components.rationale: Required by all query paths. Correct error messages. No issues.

components.name: update_plan atomic plan replacement
components.purpose: Replace task's DagPlan atomically; acquires per-task mutex (PRD §5.7)

components.purpose: OnceLock-backed HashMap managing per-task Arc<Mutex<()>> for serializing concurrent writes
components.rationale: Correct concurrency primitive. OnceLock cheaper than RwLock for init-once. Per-task (not global) enables parallelism. Used by all write paths. Essential.

slice: runner.rs + worker.rs + worktree.rs + process_util.rs (claw-fleet-task task dispatch system)
summary: Core Fleet dispatch machinery: worker spawning orchestrated by TaskRunner, 3-layer system prompt injection for context/constraints, per-P-item git worktree isolation with fast-forward merge back to task branch, and cross-platform process hardening. The system enforces P-item boundary semantics via git + SIGSTOP hook (touches), and scales workers without ordering constraints.

components.name: TaskRunner::step()
components.purpose: Main dispatch loop: checks task status, looks for unblocked P-items, acquires write lock, marks item Running, and dequeues worker spawn
components.rationale: Essential lifecycle state machine. Maps directly to Phase 1 requirement: task status → next dispatchable P-item. Atomic write-lock ensures consistency with concurrent reaper. This is the canonical dispatch entry point.

components.name: TaskRunner::dispatch_next_pitem()
components.purpose: Atomic state transition (WaitDeps→Running), provision worktree per P-item, build WorkerSpawnSpec, enqueue worker via host
components.rationale: Non-negotiable. Coordinates (1) task state mutation, (2) worktree provisioning, (3) spawn spec construction, (4) worker enqueue. The critical choreography that guarantees each P-item gets exactly one worker at its dispatch time. No simpler equivalent exists.

components.name: TaskLifecycleHost trait
components.purpose: Abstraction layer: resolve workspace, spawn master/worker, pause/resume/terminate sessions
components.rationale: Dependency injection point for Phase 1 (SupervisorHost via fleet-core) → Phase 2 (LocalHost via fleet-task binary). Allows testing without subprocess machinery. Canonically separates orchestration from execution transport.

components.name: LlmMediator trait
components.purpose: Inject merge-conflict resolution provider; stub in Phase 2, real provider Phase 3
components.rationale: Clean interface for out-of-band conflict handling. Maps to spec-fidelity (2) traceability: resolution decisions are audit-logged via git merge commits. Stub is harmless until Phase 3 wires a real LLM.

components.name: compose_worker_system_prompt()
components.purpose: Assemble 3-layer system prompt: project constants (L1) + task context (L2) + P-item details (L3)
components.rationale: Direct implementation of PRD §5.6: TASKS P7's 3-layer context injection. Layer 1 = project REQs (cached), Layer 2 = task REQs (shared), Layer 3 = P-item REQs (per-dispatch). Foundational for spec fidelity: worker sees exact boundary conditions.

components.name: compose_layer1()
components.purpose: Project constants: architecture overview + P-item execution constraints (isolated worktree, touches-only edit, no manual commits)
components.rationale: Encodes Phase 1 hard constraints. Line 99-104 explicitly documents 'touches' enforcement + SIGSTOP hook + fast-forward merge discipline. This is the canonical constraint statement that workers trust.

components.name: compose_layer2()
components.purpose: Task context: title, description, inbox materials (wrapped in untrusted tags), acceptance audit summary
components.rationale: Maps to spec-fidelity (1) registry: task-level requirements visible to all workers. Untrusted tags enable safe injection of user-supplied text. Acceptance criteria are (2) traceability hooks: master audits against them post-completion.

components.name: compose_layer3()
components.purpose: P-item private: description, touches file list, acceptance criteria, upstream dependency summaries
components.rationale: Per-dispatch requirement snapshot. Touches list is (1) boundary registration. Upstream summaries are (2) traceability: task DAG context carried forward. Output summary request (line 194-196) drives (3) deviation ledger: worker self-reports impacts.

components.name: run_post_completion_check()
components.purpose: PRD patch §6: cargo check fallback. Walks P-item touches for Rust crates, runs check --package per crate, returns structured result
components.rationale: Phase 1 spec-fidelity gap: this is **not a canonical acceptance criterion**. It's a fallback sanity check. If Rust builds don't fail, P-item acceptance does *not* automatically pass — master still audits against explicit acceptance criteria. Recommendation: TRANSFORM into (2) traceability schema: log each cargo check invocation + result as a deviation-ledger entry (so master can cite it in audit decisions) rather than a hard pass/fail gate.

components.name: rust_crates_touched()
components.purpose: Walk touches paths upward, find nearest Cargo.toml with [package], collect crate directories
components.rationale: Pure implementation detail of cargo check fallback. If the fallback is transformed into a (3) deviation-ledger entry, this detection logic becomes optional. Rust projects that only touch documentation files or don't have workspace layout shouldn't require implicit build checks.

components.name: WorkerSpawnSpec struct
components.purpose: Data carrier: task_id, p_item_id, cwd, system_prompt, model
components.rationale: Immutable specification for worker spawn. Ensures all dispatch context is captured atomically. Useful for audit trail (Phase 3: log spawn specs to deviation ledger).

components.name: worker_spawn_spec()
components.purpose: Factory: fetch P-item from task plan, compose system prompt, return WorkerSpawnSpec
components.rationale: Pure builder. Ensures P-item existence before spawn attempt. No side effects, safe to call multiple times.

components.name: provision() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Idempotent worktree provisioning: check existing/orphan, create P-item branch from task branch, spawn git worktree
components.rationale: Canonical per-P-item isolation mechanism. Ensures each worker gets a clean, isolated workspace. Idempotency (lines 64-77) handles failures + retries safely. Maps to spec-fidelity: P-item boundary enforcement.

components.name: merge_back() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Fast-forward or 3-way merge P-item branch back to task branch; detect conflicts and abort if needed
components.rationale: Core fast-forward merge orchestration. Phase 1 spec: try FF (common case), fall back to real 3-way merge, detect conflicts and abort cleanly. Essential for spec-fidelity (2) traceability: merge commits are audit trail. Fast-forward is canonical for non-conflicting linear P-item sequences.

components.name: apply_resolutions() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Re-attempt merge with LLM-mediated conflict resolutions; verify no unresolved files remain
components.rationale: Phase 3 prep (Phase 2 stub). Ensures mediation completeness: if LLM leaves unresolved conflicts, abort and error. Maps to spec-fidelity: (2) traceability (merge commits record resolution source), (3) deviation ledger (record which files required mediation).

components.name: reap() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Tear down P-item worktree + fleet branch; best-effort, tolerates missing entries
components.rationale: Garbage collection. Essential for task cleanup after P-item completion. Preserves specification (2) traceability by keeping merge commits in main workspace history.

components.name: list_for_task() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Enumerate provisioned worktrees for a task (filesystem scan, no git involvement)
components.rationale: Enables task cleanup and monitoring. Supports (2) traceability: show which P-items have been dispatched. Not spec-fidelity critical but useful for operational visibility.

components.name: gc_stale() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Garbage collect stale worktrees based on alive set; tolerates filesystem orphans
components.rationale: Disk space management. Allows supervisor to signal which (task, P-item) pairs are live and let gc_stale reap the rest. Non-critical for spec fidelity but necessary for long-running systems.

components.name: ConflictSpec struct
components.purpose: 3-way merge inputs: path, base, ours (task branch), theirs (worker branch)
components.rationale: Data carrier for conflict mediation. Maps to spec-fidelity (2) traceability: enables audit of which files conflicted and the 3-way inputs available to the LLM.

components.name: MergeOutcome enum
components.purpose: Result type: FastForwarded, AutoMerged, NoChanges, Conflict (with specs & reason)
components.rationale: Structured result. Enables caller (master) to decide: pass NoChanges through, log AutoMerged for (2) traceability, defer Conflict to LLM mediator. Maps cleanly to spec-fidelity decision tree.

components.name: command() in process_util.rs
components.purpose: Construct Command with CREATE_NO_WINDOW already applied on Windows (no-op elsewhere)
components.rationale: Cross-platform subprocess hardenning. Eliminates GUI flash on Windows. Not spec-fidelity core but necessary for user experience in desktop context (fleet-task binary).

components.name: no_window() in process_util.rs
components.purpose: Apply CREATE_NO_WINDOW flag on Windows, no-op elsewhere; chainable
components.rationale: Same rationale as command(). Enables one-liner pattern without manual &mut plumbing. Quality-of-life for subprocess creation throughout codebase.

components.name: collect_conflict_specs() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Walk index stages 1/2/3 for each conflicted path, extract base/ours/theirs blob content
components.rationale: Enables (2) traceability: conflict mediation audit trail. Records exact 3-way inputs that LLM sees. Pure data extraction, no side effects.

components.name: checkout_branch() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Set HEAD to branch ref, force checkout working tree
components.rationale: Implementation detail of merge_back. Ensures task_branch is checked out before merge. Essential for correctness but not separately audited — always called from merge_back.

components.name: fast_forward_to() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Update task_branch ref to worker commit, checkout working tree
components.rationale: Canonical fast-forward operation. Creates audit trail via ref update message ('fleet: fast-forward'). Essential for spec-fidelity (2) traceability: every FF is recorded in reflog.

components.name: finish_merge_commit() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Write tree, create merge commit with 2 parents (HEAD + worker branch), cleanup merge state
components.rationale: Finalizes 3-way merges. Records resolution path in commit. Essential for spec-fidelity (2) traceability: merge commit is canonical audit record.

components.name: abort_merge() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Equivalent to git merge --abort: cleanup state, hard reset working tree + index
components.rationale: Essential for safety: if merge_back detects conflicts, abort immediately to leave workspace clean. Prevents half-finished merges. Non-negotiable for reliable operations.

components.name: blob_to_string() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Fetch blob object content, convert to string (or empty string if oid is None)
components.rationale: Helper for collect_conflict_specs. Handles missing stages (e.g., file added on one side). Pure, side-effect free.

components.name: git_revlist_count() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Count commits in head not in base (git rev-list --count base..head) via libgit2
components.rationale: Used by merge_back to count commits_merged. Pure computation, no I/O besides reading git objects.

components.name: open_repo() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Open git repository at workspace path
components.rationale: Lightweight helper. Used throughout worktree.rs. Standard error wrapping.

components.name: worktree_root() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Return FLEET_HOME/.fleet/worktrees path
components.rationale: Configuration point for P-item worktree storage. Enables overrides in tests. Necessary for multi-task isolation.

components.name: worktree_path() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Compute path for (task_id, p_item_id) worktree (no existence check)
components.rationale: Path computation. Pure function, no I/O. Used by provision, reap, list_for_task, gc_stale.

components.name: worktree_branch() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Return fleet branch name for (task_id, p_item_id): fleet/{task_id}/{p_item_id}
components.rationale: Canonical naming scheme for P-item branches. Pure function. Enables consistent branch management across provision, merge_back, reap.

components.name: worktree_meta_name() in worktree.rs
components.purpose: Sanitize task_id + p_item_id for libgit2 worktree metadata directory name (no slashes)
components.rationale: Implementation detail. Handles sanitization required by libgit2 (worktree names must be filesystem-safe). Pure function.

components.name: crate_name_from_cargo_toml() in worker.rs
components.purpose: Naive parse of Cargo.toml to extract [package] name
components.rationale: Implementation detail of run_post_completion_check. If the fallback is transformed into (3) deviation-ledger, crate detection can be simplified or removed. Current naive regex is fragile (comments, formatting variations).

components.name: CrateCheckResult struct
components.purpose: Structured result of cargo check --package: crate name, ok bool, stderr tail
components.rationale: Result type for cargo check fallback. If fallback is TRANSFORMED into (3) deviation-ledger entry, keep as structured representation of check result. Otherwise same fate as run_post_completion_check.

components.name: PostCompletionCheck struct
components.purpose: Structured result of post-completion checks: ok bool, crate results, combined stderr
components.rationale: Same as CrateCheckResult. If fallback is TRANSFORMED, keep. Else UNCERTAIN.

slice: CLI actions, task registry, path conventions, and orchestration infrastructure in fleet-task crate
summary: This slice implements the task lifecycle orchestration (new/dispatch/mark-done/pause/resume/clear), runtime registry for process discovery, normalized path conventions aligned with core, and empty architecture_overview loading framework. Most components are orchestration-core and storage (non-canonical to methodology), with no explicit requirements traceability, deviation logging, or auditor integration.

components.name: start_task
components.purpose: Transition task from Drafting/Planning/Ready to Running; creates git branch, spawns Master, persists started_at + master_session_id
components.rationale: Essential state machine transition needed for task execution. However, currently lacks traceability: no link to REQ-NNN, no artifact tagging for deviation auditing. Should be instrumented with requirement origin tracking.

components.name: dispatch_pitem
components.purpose: Master tool to dispatch worker for p_item_id; flips status to Running, provisions worktree, enqueues Worker session
components.rationale: Core execution flow. Like start_task, lacks requirement tagging and deviation annotation—should record which REQ-NNN initiated this dispatch and any unplanned scope changes.

components.name: mark_done
components.purpose: Mark P-item Done, merge worktree back, handle 3-way conflicts via LlmMediator, persist acceptance-audit summary
components.rationale: Closure point for work; should capture accept/reject evidence and link to requirement coverage. Currently accepts bare `summary` string—should enforce structured audit metadata (which REQ proved, evidence, deviation declaration if simplified).

components.name: mark_failed
components.purpose: Mark P-item Failed with FailReason, propagate skip on downstream items
components.rationale: Failure is a deviation from plan. Should capture: which REQ failed, why (root cause), what workaround applied, who approved. Currently only records FailReason enum—needs structured deviation entry per deviation-ledger spec.

components.name: pause_task / resume_task
components.purpose: Pause running task (SIGSTOP), resume paused task (SIGCONT)
components.rationale: Pure operational convenience, not load-bearing for methodology. Maintenance burden for no canonical value. External tools can manage process signals.

components.name: clear_task
components.purpose: Delete task—SIGTERM sessions, remove task JSON + materials, mark Abandoned
components.rationale: Cleanup operation, not essential to methodology. Risks data loss if misused. If retained, should require audit log entry and approval tracking (violates current design).

components.name: RegistryEntry (runtime registry)
components.purpose: JSON snapshot of live fleet-task process: task_id, pid, port, started_at (RFC3339)
components.rationale: Essential process discovery mechanism. However, should extend to include: requirement ID being executed, current P-item status, acceptance criteria progress. Rename field to clarify it's a runtime process registry, not requirements registry.

components.name: list_alive (registry)
components.purpose: Filter live processes via kill(pid, 0) probe; return RegistryEntry list
components.rationale: Prevents stale data in discovery. Operationally sound. No canonical tie, but supporting infrastructure is low-cost.

components.name: prune_stale (registry)
components.purpose: Delete registry entries for dead pids; used at bootstrap
components.rationale: Hygiene operation. Low cost, idempotent, no methodology conflict.

components.name: real_home_dir / get_fleet_dir (paths.rs)
components.purpose: Mirror core's path resolution with FLEET_HOME override; bypass sandbox redirection
components.rationale: Canonical location for all fleet state. Essential for deterministic, reproducible execution. Avoid separate path conventions.

components.name: fleet_home_lock (paths.rs)
components.purpose: Process-wide mutex for FLEET_HOME env var serialization in tests
components.rationale: Test infrastructure only, not user-facing. Zero methodology impact, tiny footprint.

components.name: init_utf8 (console.rs)
components.purpose: Set Windows console to UTF-8 (CP 65001) to prevent GBK garbling on zh-CN systems
components.rationale: UX correctness for international users. No methodology tie but essential for legible output. Low risk.

components.name: architecture_path / load_for_project (architecture_overview.rs)
components.purpose: Load ~.fleet/projects/{project_id}/architecture.md for Layer 1 session context; hand-authored or user-provided
components.rationale: Currently unstructured, free-form markdown. Should align with architecture documentation tied to REQ-NNN (which subsystems address which requirements, traceability by design). V2 auto-generation via indexer agent per spec—defer full build, but rename/annotate as 'specification artifact, not implementation architecture'.

components.name: render_layer1_block (architecture_overview.rs)
components.purpose: Compose Layer 1 markdown block for master/worker session SYSTEM prompt
components.rationale: Useful for agent onboarding, but current design conflates system-level architecture (req-to-design mapping) with implementation details. Should clarify: is this for agent behavior constraints (belongs in CLAUDE.md), or design spec (belongs in REQ→design artifact)? Depends on V2 indexer output shape.

components.name: TaskHost trait + enqueue_master / enqueue_worker / resolve_conflicts (runner)
components.purpose: Abstraction over host callbacks (spawn master/worker, resolve 3-way merges); allows fleet-task binary to reuse core's lifecycle logic
components.rationale: Clean dependency inversion. Enables standalone fleet-task binary and future auditor agent integration. Should extend to: provide requirement context to master/worker, capture acceptance signatures back.

components.name: PItemStatus enum + state transitions (mark_done, mark_failed, dispatch_pitem)
components.purpose: P-item lifecycle: WaitDeps/WaitResource → Running → Done|Failed|Skipped
components.rationale: Essential state machine. Should extend PItemStatus to carry acceptance metadata: which REQ covered, audit signature, deviation reason if bypassed.

components.name: Task write lock (actions.rs)
components.purpose: Mutex around get_task → modify → write_task_atomic to prevent race conditions
components.rationale: Concurrency safety. Essential for atomicity. No methodology tie but non-negotiable.

components.name: merged_back / apply_resolutions (worktree merge in mark_done)
components.purpose: Merge worker worktree back to task branch; handle 3-way conflicts via LlmMediator
components.rationale: Merge is a critical validation gate. Should log all conflict resolutions in deviation ledger (what merged, why, who approved). Currently silent—add audit trail linking merged artifacts to REQ coverage proof.

slice: fleet-task 二进制 crate 与 spec-fidelity 方法论的适配分析
summary: fleet-task 是 Phase 2 独立二进制，统一管理单个 task 的完整生命周期（master + workers + plan）。架构分层清晰：CLI 入口 → runtime boot（task 创建+分支+master 启动+registry） → HTTP/SSE 暴露 → TUI 渲染 → LocalHost 进程管理。与 claw-fleet-task 库耦合紧密。分析表明：需求注册表和偏差账本在现代码缺失；可追溯矩阵仅存于测试；对抗审计完全无；UX/storage/orchestration-core 混杂。方法论四要件有效性评分：1/4。建议：核心能力（boot、HTTP、registry 交互、进程生命周期）应保留但需强化元数据追踪；UX（TUI、launchpad）非方法论核心，宜剪去或转移；偏离注册表的自动项目发现逻辑待明确；mock/test 基础设施虽好但缺方法论牙咬合。

components.name: boot_new_task
components.purpose: 创建新 task、初始化分支、启动 master agent、写入 registry
components.rationale: 直接对应需求注册表第一步——task 原子创建。但现有代码只写 registry，未声明需求 REQ-NNN。应扩展为：(1) 解析/验证输入参数为需求预检；(2) task.json 中标记 REQ- 源头；(3) 记录 boot_new_task 何时被调用及参数。保留核心逻辑，增强元数据。

components.name: boot_resume
components.purpose: 恢复暂停/停止的 task，重启 master，恢复 task 状态
components.rationale: Resume 路径必须明确：task 何时进入 Paused 状态、何时被 Resume。现有代码的 task.status flip 隐含了状态转移但未显式记录。应添加：(1) 偏差账本条目记录 Paused→Running 转移原因；(2) 可追溯性：master_session_id 记录每个 resume 的新会话。保留，强化追踪。

components.name: finish_boot (internal)
components.purpose: 初始化 broadcaster、dispatcher、HTTP 服务，完成 bootstrap 序列
components.rationale: 封装了 Phase 2/3 P8 的核心交互：registry write + HTTP spawn + dispatcher 连线。代表了 fleet-task 作为 orchestration 宿主的本质。无对偶需求注册表条目的风险，但应文档化为内部 P8 specification。保留。

components.name: lookup_project_id & derive_auto_project_id
components.purpose: 查表项目 ID 或自动生成 workspace-stable 虚拟项目 ID
components.rationale: 方法论四要件中无对应。这是 Phase 3/5 的前期设计（使 fleet-task 生成的 task 在桌面 UI 中分组可见）。逻辑正确但属架构演进细节而非规范能力。自动项目发现（auto-<16hex>）缺方法论权声（无 REQ-auto-discovery）。如规范明确要求 workspace 分组，应升为 REQ；否则作为实现细节，可转到库中（不属 fleet-task 二进制）。目前倾向 transform：移入 claw-fleet-task lib，binary 仅调用。

components.name: shutdown_with_deadline
components.purpose: 优雅关闭：SIGTERM → 轮询 PID 存活 → SIGKILL 超期进程 → 清理 registry
components.rationale: 进程生命周期管理核心。表现优雅关闭的 SLA：30s 墙钟时间。需添加：(1) 关闭步骤日志为机器可读的偏差账本（如 'SIGKILL-after-30s'）；(2) 退出状态码文档化（如 exit 130 = operator SIGINT twice）。保留，增强可追溯性。

components.name: pid_alive_reaping
components.purpose: 检探 PID 存活状态，同时进行 zombie reap（waitpid WNOHANG）
components.rationale: Process 清理中的关键细节。Phase 2 已知局限（zombie 直到进程退出）应文档化为需求偏差。现有代码正确，注释清晰。保留。

components.name: http::spawn（HTTP 服务器）
components.purpose: 启动 127.0.0.1 局部 HTTP 服务器，暴露 /health /state /events /p-items/* 端点
components.rationale: fleet-task 作为 daemon 的外部接口。端点列表应作 specification API contract（可追溯为 REQ-http-api）。但现有实现无版本控制、无向后兼容性宣言。应升级为：(1) 端点签名 versioned（/v1/health）；(2) 每个端点关联需求 REQ-http-<name>；(3) 错误码文档化为规范。保留并强化规范。

components.name: DispatchTrigger trait
components.purpose: 桥接 HTTP dispatch 端点与 LocalHost 的 worker 启动
components.rationale: Phase 3 P8 明确设计的通道（POST /p-items/<id>/dispatch → actions::dispatch_pitem）。代表了 fleet-task 作为 task runner 的核心。无对偶 REQ，但应标注为 P3-P8 requirement。保留。

components.name: SseBroadcaster
components.purpose: 推送运行时事件给 /events 订户（事件流格式：SSE）
components.rationale: UX 能力（实时反馈），但实现本身是核心基础设施。现有 pattern（重复 SseClient 死连追踪）是合理的。应标注为 REQ-sse-events；事件类型（p_item.spawned 等）应列入 specification。保留，增强规范。

components.name: LocalHost（进程宿主）
components.purpose: TaskLifecycleHost 实现，管理本进程内的 master/worker pids，暴露 pause/resume/terminate
components.rationale: fleet-task 的核心多进程管理。直接实现了 Phase 2 的单机进程模型。应强化：(1) 每个 session record 标注 REQ-session-track；(2) signal 操作（SIGSTOP/SIGCONT/SIGTERM）作为 specification behaviors；(3) 逻辑正确，tests 完整。保留。

components.name: ProcessLauncher trait & ClaudeLauncher
components.purpose: 抽象 claude 子进程启动，允许 test mock 和 fake launcher
components.rationale: 好的抽象。ClaudeLauncher 的环境变量注入（FLEET_SESSION_ID, FLEET_SESSION_KIND, FLEET_TASK_ID, FLEET_P_ITEM_ID）是 master/worker 的通信协议。应提升为 REQ-launch-protocol。现有 FAKE_LAUNCHER_ENV 检查允许单元测试脱离 claude 二进制，符合 specification 友好设计。保留。

components.name: spawn_claude 函数
components.purpose: 构造 claude CLI 命令行，附加环境变量和 system prompt
components.rationale: protocol 实现细节。环境变量列表、prompt 模板应版本化（phase 版本号）。保留，文档化为 specification behavior。

components.name: run (主 TUI 循环)
components.purpose: ratatui 前端，按状态分组渲染 P-items，轮询任务更新（250ms），接收 q/Ctrl-C
components.rationale: 纯 UX，非方法论核心。方法论要求追踪规范性，TUI 仅读与渲染。选项：(1) cut — fleet-task 若做成 pure daemon（--no-tui），可脱离 TUI 只用 HTTP 客户端；(2) transform — TUI 转移到桌面 UI 或单独 fleet-cli 工具；(3) keep — 如规范明确要求交互式 TUI 视图。倾向 transform：TUI 不是 fleet-task 的专属职责，应由消费方（desktop UI / CLI 包装）提供。

components.name: run_launchpad 及 LaunchScreen
components.purpose: 二屏幕 TUI：新任务提示符 + 任务列表选择器（Ctrl-T 切换）
components.rationale: 纯 convenience UX（镜像 claude 裸启动）。方法论无需求。占代码 150+ 行，维护成本（TextArea widget、picker state machine）高。若 --no-tui 已支持，应删除此路径，文档化使用 fleet-task new 代替。三个切换点（LaunchAction::StartNew / Resume / Quit）可在脚本或 CLI wrapper 中实现。倾向 cut，除非方法论明确要求交互式工作流导入。

components.name: run_picker（任务选择器）
components.purpose: 全屏列表 TUI，显示磁盘上所有 tasks，可按 ↑↓ 导航，Enter 恢复
components.rationale: 列表渲染能力有用，但 TUI 实现无方法论必要。应改为：(1) list 命令输出 JSON（--json flag），让消费方格式化；(2) 或删除 run_picker，提供 task list API 给桌面 UI。TUI 维护成本（ListState、picker_loop 状态机）不合理。倾向 cut，转为 --json 输出。

components.name: render_p_items 及 status_label
components.purpose: 将 task.plan 的 PItems 按状态分组，着色显示
components.rationale: 渲染逻辑本身无方法论锚点，但 PItem 状态机（WAIT/WAITR/RUN/DONE/SKIP/FAIL/GATE）应作 specification。现有状态映射到着色是展示问题。应转为：(1) 状态列表 → 规范文档 REQ-pitem-status；(2) 渲染移入共享库或 JSON 序列化器；(3) fleet-task TUI 仅调用，不拥有。

components.name: render_status（底部状态栏）
components.purpose: 显示 task title、status、HTTP port、PID、快捷键提示
components.rationale: 调试视图。若 fleet-task 转为 daemon-first，外部客户端可通过 /state 端点查询。保留在 TUI 中无必要。倾向 cut，除非需求明确声明 'TUI 状态栏必须显示 port'。

components.name: main.rs CLI 命令树（new/resume/list）
components.purpose: 三个子命令路由 + 裸启动（launchpad）
components.rationale: fleet-task 的命令行接口。应升级为规范 API：(1) 每个子命令关联 REQ-cmd-new / REQ-cmd-resume / REQ-cmd-list；(2) 参数列表版本化；(3) 退出码标准化（0=success, 1=user-error, 2=system-error）。裸启动（run_launchpad）方案待决。保留 new/resume/list，uncertain 对 launchpad。

components.name: install_signals（SIGINT/SIGTERM 处理）
components.purpose: 安装全局信号处理器，第一次信号优雅关闭，第二次强制 exit(130)
components.rationale: 关闭行为应标准化为 specification。现有双击 SIGINT 设计（graceful-then-force）应作 REQ-signal-handling。保留，增强规范。

components.name: run_task 函数
components.purpose: 前台循环：打印 HTTP port，选择 TUI 或 headless，等待 stop flag，优雅关闭
components.rationale: 主程序流。30s 关闭 deadline 是 specification behavior。--no-tui 支持允许 daemon 模式。保留，文档化为 specification behavior。

components.name: 测试基础设施（SleepLauncher, FleetHomeOverride）
components.purpose: 单元测试 mocks：用 sleep 60 替代 claude，允许隔离测试
components.rationale: Test harness 质量高，体现了规范友好设计。无方法论锚点，但支持了可测试性。保留。应扩展：添加 'deviation marker'（如 #[deviation("Phase-2", "zombie PID")]）到每个已知限制。

components.name: HTTP 端点 /health, /state, /events, /p-items/*
components.purpose: RESTful 暴露面，允许外部客户端查询 task 状态和订阅事件
components.rationale: fleet-task 作为 daemon 的核心 API 契约。应规范化为 REQ-http-{endpoint}。现有实现稳定，缺版本控制。保留，升级为规范。

components.name: Registry 读写（registry::write, registry::read）
components.purpose: 将 task metadata（pid, port, started_at）写入 ~/.fleet/registry，允许外部进程发现
components.rationale: 需求注册表的物理载体。应升级规范：(1) registry schema 版本化；(2) 每个字段标注 REQ-registry-<field>；(3) TTL 和 cleanup 策略标准化；(4) 写失败处理（当前仅 eprintln）。保留并强化。

components.name: task.workspace 持久化
components.purpose: 在 task.json 中存储 workspace 路径，允许 Phase 3+ resume 无需 --workspace
components.rationale: 存储设计演进（Phase 2 缺失 → Phase 3+）。现有逻辑（Phase 3 会填充，Phase 2 需参数）应作偏差账本条目。保留，标注为 Phase-2-limitation。

components.name: project_id 自动发现逻辑
components.purpose: 若 workspace 已在 projects.json 注册则用其 id，否则生成 auto-<hash>
components.rationale: Phase 3/5 前期优化，缺方法论权声。若需求明确说 'multi-workspace task grouping'，应升为 REQ。现阶段倾向 transform：移入库，binary 仅调用。或作为内部实现细节，保留但标注 'Phase-3-forward-compat'。

summary: This slice implements three core enforcement capabilities for spec-fidelity: (1) touches_hook intercepts Edit/Write tool calls to prevent undeclared file modification (boundary enforcement), (2) merge_mediator resolves 3-way conflicts via LLM for deterministic acceptance audits, (3) worker_executor composes 3-layer system prompts (Layer 1: project constants, Layer 2: task description, Layer 3: P-item spec with touches/acceptance/upstream summaries), and (4) audit_patterns provides risk-level classification of bash commands. All four components directly address methodology requirement 1 (specification fidelity via registry/acceptance), requirement 3 (deviation tracking via violation markers), and requirement 4 (adversarial audit via risk patterns). However, some scaffolding and utility structures lack direct methodology mapping.

components.name: TouchesDecision enum
components.purpose: Outcome of evaluating whether an Edit/Write tool call's target path falls within declared P-item boundaries
components.rationale: Directly implements boundary enforcement: Allow vs Block decision is the foundation for recording deviations when touches are violated. Block outcome triggers violation marker recording (lines 72-75), feeding the append-only ledger system.

components.name: check_path_against_touches function
components.purpose: Pure decision logic: compares attempted file path against declared touches using suffix-aware matching (workspace-relative vs absolute path normalization)
components.rationale: Core enforcement gate. Suffix-based matching (lines 83-104) solves real-world path variance without false-negatives that could drift. Tests (lines 220-272) validate boundary cases. Essential for deterministic specification fidelity.

components.name: TouchesViolationMarker struct
components.purpose: Persisted JSON marker dropped to ~/.fleet/touches-violations/ when worker attempts undeclared edit; contains task_id, p_item_id, attempted_path, declared_touches, worker_session_id, recorded_at
components.rationale: Append-only ledger entry (methodology requirement 3). Supervisor polls directory (lines 161-186) and replays violations into master event stream (PRD §5.x). No mutation—only create + drain pattern. Traceability root cause.

components.name: violations_dir / record_violation / drain_violations functions
components.purpose: Lifecycle management: directory resolution, atomic write to violations dir, ordered drain for supervisor replay
components.rationale: Append-only ledger mechanics. Ordered drain (line 179 sorts by recorded_at) ensures master replays deviations in causality order. No overwrite, no mutation—pure append + drain. Critical for audit trail.

components.name: normalise / paths_match / is_suffix_of helpers
components.purpose: Path normalization (collapse .., .), suffix-boundary matching to avoid false matches (foo.rs != bar_foo.rs)
components.rationale: Pure utility functions, but they solve a real specification-fidelity problem: ambiguous path matching would produce false-positives/negatives, undermining boundary enforcement. Tests at lines 220-272 validate correctness.

components.name: MediationResult / MediationError enums
components.purpose: Output of conflict resolution: resolved file content or error variants (ProviderUnavailable, EmptyResponse, MarkersLeftBehind, MissingWrapper)
components.rationale: Deterministic acceptance criteria for merge completion (PRD §P11). Error taxonomy enables master to decide per-file retry vs escalation. MarkersLeftBehind (lines 40-42) is a sanity check—LLM output must be clean, aligning with spec-fidelity principle.

components.name: render_prompt function
components.purpose: Pure function: fills MEDIATOR_PROMPT_TEMPLATE with ConflictSpec (path, base, ours, theirs) for LLM input
components.rationale: Part of deterministic merge workflow. Template-based rendering (lines 113-119) ensures consistent input shape for audit/replay. Tests (lines 252-264) verify no raw placeholders leak through.

components.name: extract_resolved / first_conflict_marker functions
components.purpose: Extract LLM's resolved content from <resolved>...</resolved> tags; sanity-check for leftover conflict markers (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>)
components.rationale: Acceptance gate for mediation output (lines 124-147). Refusal of marker-bearing content (lines 138-146) prevents downstream acceptance audit from failing on corrupted merges. Essential fidelity checkpoint.

components.name: mediate_one / mediate_with / mediate functions
components.purpose: Run conflict resolution: mediate_one handles single file via provider, mediate_with allows test injection, mediate uses default provider
components.rationale: Functional separation (lines 151-201): mediate_one is pure and testable; mediate_with enables DI for test providers; mediate wraps production. Stop-at-first-error strategy (line 192) prevents cascading failures. Tests thoroughly validate error paths.

components.name: MEDIATOR_PROMPT_TEMPLATE constant
components.purpose: Hardcoded prompt for Sonnet: instructs LLM to preserve non-conflicting changes, prefer THEIRS, emit no markers, wrap output in <resolved> tags
components.rationale: Specification of acceptable merge behavior. Template structure (lines 80-109) is deterministic and audit-friendly: explicit wrapper tags allow reliable extraction; 'preserve non-conflicting' + 'prefer THEIRS' are reproducible heuristics for conflicts.

components.name: MEDIATOR_MODEL / MEDIATOR_TIMEOUT constants
components.purpose: Worker defaults to claude-sonnet-4-6; timeout 120s per file to escalate runaway resolutions
components.rationale: Cost/reliability trade-off baked into spec: Sonnet (not Opus) for merge to keep per-file cost low; 120s timeout prevents budget burn. Both are part of deterministic execution contract.

components.name: FakeProvider test harness
components.purpose: Records seen_prompts and returns canned responses for unit tests without LLM
components.rationale: Pure test scaffolding but enables thorough coverage of mediate_one logic (lines 296-341). Tests validate all error paths without network dependency. Good testing hygiene.

components.name: WorkerSpawnSpec struct
components.purpose: Contract between supervisor and worker subprocess: task_id, p_item_id, cwd, system_prompt, model
components.rationale: Specification of worker dispatch. system_prompt field (line 36) is the critical interface: it carries the full 3-layer context that enforces spec fidelity. Model selection (line 39) is part of execution contract.

components.name: worker_spawn_spec function
components.purpose: Build WorkerSpawnSpec for one P-item: looks up P-item in task plan, calls compose_worker_system_prompt, returns spec ready to spawn
components.rationale: Factory for worker specs (lines 51-68). Error when P-item not in plan (line 59) prevents dispatch of malformed specs. Pure, testable, deterministic.

components.name: compose_worker_system_prompt function
components.purpose: Assemble full worker SYSTEM prompt: Layer 1 (project constants) + Layer 2 (task context) + Layer 3 (P-item spec)
components.rationale: Core spec-fidelity injection point (lines 72-79). Worker sees complete specification: architecture overview (Layer 1, line 74), task description + materials (Layer 2, line 76), P-item details + touches + acceptance + upstream summaries (Layer 3, line 78). This 3-layer structure is the specification registry delivered to the agent.

components.name: compose_layer1 function
components.purpose: Render Layer 1: architecture overview from render_layer1_block + execution constraints (isolation, touches enforcement, no commits)
components.rationale: Project-level constants (lines 84-106). Constraints at lines 99-103 explicitly state the spec: edit only declared touches, SIGSTOPped for violations, no manual commits. Cacheable (prompt cache) since same for all workers in project.

components.name: compose_layer2 function
components.purpose: Render Layer 2: task title, description, inbox materials, wrapped in <untrusted_*> tags
components.rationale: Task constants (lines 111-144). Same for every P-item in task, so cacheable. <untrusted_*> wrapper (lines 140-141) is defensive: signals to worker that materials may contain adversarial content. Cacheable with Layer 1.

components.name: compose_layer3 function
components.purpose: Render Layer 3: P-item-specific context (desc, touches list, acceptance criteria, upstream output summaries from dependencies)
components.rationale: P-item specification (lines 148-200). Touches (lines 149-158) is the specification boundary. Acceptance (lines 159-168) is the acceptance audit spec worker should target. Upstream summaries (lines 170-186) provide traceability to dependencies. Per-P-item, not cacheable. Lines 194-196 explicitly instruct worker to write output summary for downstream use—this is the traceability link.

components.name: WORKER_MODEL constant
components.purpose: Default worker model: claude-sonnet-4-6
components.rationale: Part of execution spec. Sonnet tier is intentional (reserves Opus for master). Deterministic model selection is part of reproducible spec.

components.name: PostCompletionCheck / CrateCheckResult structs
components.purpose: Result of post-completion cargo check: ok bool, per-crate results with stderr tail, combined stderr
components.rationale: Acceptance criterion check (PRD patch §6, lines 204-216). Rust compilation must pass for spec fidelity. Structured result (lines 218-223) allows master to decide per-crate retry vs escalate. Not every build failure → plan failure; master has discretion.

components.name: rust_crates_touched / run_post_completion_check functions
components.purpose: Walk touches paths to find Cargo.toml files; run cargo check per crate, collect results
components.rationale: Validation gate (lines 228-325). Deduplication by crate dir (line 229) prevents redundant checks. Does not mutate task state (line 261 comment)—supervisor decides handling. Pure side-effect-free logic for main path; side-effects (cargo check) are isolated and result-bearing.

components.name: crate_name_from_cargo_toml helper
components.purpose: Naive parse of Cargo.toml to extract [package] name field
components.rationale: Utility that works, but fragile (naive regex-like parsing). However, fallback exists (line 275-279 uses dir name), so not critical. Keeps code simple.

components.name: audit_patterns.json structure: patterns array with level/tag/match_mode/patterns
components.purpose: Builtin Bash audit rules: sudo, eval-exec, chmod-dangerous, curl-upload, code-push, package-publish, network-exfil, scp-upload, network-download, ssh-remote, network-scan, git-clone, git-reset-hard, file-deletion, docker-exec, k8s-mutate, process-kill, git-fetch, git-local-destructive, package-install, npx-exec, cloud-cli, open-external, scheduled-task, permission-change
components.rationale: Core adversarial audit patterns (lines 3-171). Classifies bash commands by risk level (critical, high, medium) using match_mode (Contains, CommandStart). Each pattern is a boundary: critical patterns (sudo, eval, code-push, etc.) trigger master escalation. These patterns are the 'independent auditor' checking for out-of-spec behavior.

components.name: audit_patterns.json structure: python_patterns array
components.purpose: Python-specific audit rules: http-upload, socket, email, dynamic-exec, http-download, subprocess, file-delete, ssh, file-write, pkg-install
components.rationale: Extension to bash patterns for Python code (lines 173-250). Worker might execute Python; patterns catch dangerous imports/calls. Tags like py-http-upload, py-socket are language-native risk signals. Important for comprehensive audit coverage.

components.name: AuditRiskLevel enum (Medium, High, Critical)
components.purpose: Risk classification for audit events
components.rationale: Methodology requirement 4: independent adversarial auditor with signal levels. Three-tier taxonomy (Medium/High/Critical) guides master's response (escalate, notify, pause). Maps to JSON patterns.

components.name: MatchMode enum (Contains, CommandStart)
components.purpose: Pattern matching strategy: substring vs shell command position (avoids false-positive in word boundaries)
components.rationale: Prevents false-positives (e.g., 'nc ' in 'func ' is not netcat). CommandStart uses cmd_ast to parse shell syntax properly (audit.rs comments). Deterministic matching is essential for audit reproducibility.

components.name: RuntimeRiskPattern struct in audit.rs
components.purpose: Runtime pattern: id, level, tag, match_mode, patterns list, descriptions (EN/ZH), enabled flag, builtin, category
components.rationale: Audit rule specification (lines 105-120 of audit.rs head). Builtin=true for compiled-in rules, false for user-created. Enabled flag allows dynamic disable. This structure bridges audit-patterns.json into runtime engine. Category (privilege_escalation, network, git, etc.) enables grouping for UI.

components.name: ExternalPatternsFile / builtin_patterns functions
components.purpose: Load audit patterns from ~/.fleet/fleet-audit-patterns.json or use compiled defaults
components.rationale: Allows user override of audit rules (lines 137-159 of read section), but defaults are builtin. Version field enables schema evolution. Pure blacklist (only side-effects match, read-only ignored) is correct: catch deviations, allow spec-compliant work.

components.name: AuditEvent struct with dedup_key method
components.purpose: Audit event record: session_id, workspace, agent_source, tool_name, command_summary, risk_level, risk_tags, timestamp; dedup_key = session_id|timestamp|tool_name
components.rationale: Append-only audit log entry (lines 30-55 of audit.rs head). Dedup_key (line 53) enables notification de-duplication while maintaining audit trail. Traceability: links risky command to session → worker → P-item.

components.name: UserAuditRules / load_user_rules / save_user_rules
components.purpose: User-approved 'always allow' rules: prefix matches command and short-circuits Critical risk escalation
components.rationale: User overrides of audit rules may undermine spec fidelity auditing. If user can whitelist sudo/curl-upload/code-push, the independent auditor becomes compromised. Methodology requires that deviations are caught and escalated to master, not silently approved. This feature conflicts with requirement 4 (independent audit). Either remove or add explicit master approval gate (not just user allowlist).

components.name: RegistryEntry struct and registry module
components.purpose: Runtime registry: track live fleet-task processes via ~/.fleet/runtime/<task_id>.json with task_id, pid, port, started_at
components.rationale: Process discovery mechanism (lines 17-24, 57-88 of registry.rs). Enable external tools (desktop monitor, fleet-cli) to find live tasks. list_alive filters dead pids. Not directly spec-fidelity, but enables observability of spec compliance.

components.name: FakeProvider test harness in merge_mediator
components.purpose: Mock LlmProvider for testing mediate_one without real API calls
components.rationale: Test-only code, but excellent pattern. Consider promoting to a public test-utils module so other components can reuse it. Currently at lines 212-240, but no cross-module DI pattern. Minor: keep as-is for now, but flag for refactoring if audit testing expands.

components.name: PRD references in code comments (§5.x, §6.1, patch §4, §P10, §P11, §P12)
components.purpose: Docstring anchors to PRD requirements; create traceability between code and specification
components.rationale: Implements requirement 2 (traceability matrix REQ→implementation→test). PRD anchors (e.g., 'PRD §5.x patch §4 / TASKS P8' at touches_hook.rs:6-7) are manual REQ-to-code links. Should be formalized into a requirements registry (REQ-NNN), but current practice is better than none. Aids code review and spec drift detection.

summary: 40KB task-as-unit design specifies four-pillar spec-fidelity methodology: (1) Registry—atomic REQ-001~060+ from design §3-13; (2) Traceability—REQ→src/*.rs→tests matrix; (3) Deviation Ledger—append-only cuts (DAG editor→V2, worktree→V2, LLM auto-merge→V2 Phase 2, auto architecture.md→V2); (4) Adversarial Auditor—independent agent verifies Master red lines enforced, no orphaned code. Core: Master agent (Sonnet 4.6, event-driven, long-lived, decision 6), Scheduler (pure topo+resource), three-layer context (L1~8k+cache, L2~2k+cache, L3~1-3k), P-item schema (9 fields). MVP: Inbox→planner→Kanban, no graph editor, same-branch V1, 10 patches. Bootstrap: Phase 0=manual, Phase 1=dogfood, Phase 2=worktree. All core orchestration systems must keep; non-core UX polish defer V2; backward compat + V1 bootstrap planning are meta-reqs deferred post-MVP.

components.name: Requirement Registry
components.purpose: Generate atomic REQ-001~060+ from design clauses
components.rationale: Foundational pillar. Enables all other three. Must pre-implement before code.

components.name: Traceability Matrix
components.purpose: REQ→code files:lines + test files:functions + acceptance steps + auditor sign-off
components.rationale: Accountability layer. Non-negotiable for audit.

components.name: Deviation Ledger
components.purpose: Append-only log: date|REQ affected|reason|risk|sign-off. Record ~10 deferrals from design.
components.rationale: Justification record. Design itself defers DAG editor, worktree, LLM auto-merge, auto architecture.md to V2+. Meta-requirement: create DEV-001~010 entries.

components.name: Adversarial Auditor
components.purpose: Independent agent spot-checks: Master red lines, schema consistency, unimplemented REQs, patch logic
components.rationale: Replaces master self-review. Must exist to prevent blind spots. Audits before merge→main.

components.name: Three-layer Model (Project→Task→P-item)
components.purpose: Semantic hierarchy: Project(grouping)|Task(entry unit)|P-item(DAG node)
components.rationale: Non-negotiable foundation. All scheduling depends on this.

components.name: P-item Schema (9 fields)
components.purpose: id,desc,touches,depends_on,resources,estimate,acceptance,artifacts,skippable,human_gate,status
components.rationale: All 9 fields load-bearing: touches(conflict detection), resources(scheduler), acceptance(audit), artifacts(downstream), skippable(conditional skip), human_gate(mid-task gate). Cannot simplify.

components.name: DAG Scheduling (topo+resource)
components.purpose: Three-step mechanical filter: (1)depends_on complete (2)resources free (3)dispatch
components.rationale: Core parallelism. Pure deterministic. No simplification possible.

components.name: Resource Locks
components.purpose: Built-in(build/test/git) + user-extensible(port:N,db:name). Auto-release on fail.
components.rationale: Scheduler mutex. All three built-in + auto-release must ship V1.

components.name: Master Agent
components.purpose: Sonnet 4.6, long-lived, event-driven. Coordinator: dispatch/audit/fail-fix/plan-evolve.
components.rationale: Architecture spine. Cannot replace with session-per-item-only (loses fine-grained fail recovery & plan evolution).

components.name: Master SYSTEM + Red Lines
components.purpose: Normative constraints: no direct code edit, skip audit, pause/resume, fleet config modification
components.rationale: Safety boundaries. Auditor must verify violations trigger test failures.

components.name: Worker Session
components.purpose: Per P-item subprocess: fresh Layer 3 context, write output_summary, terminate
components.rationale: Parallelism unit. V1 same-branch; V2 worktree-per-item.

components.name: Three-layer Context Caching
components.purpose: L1(~8k)+L2(~2k)→Anthropic 5min cache→90%+ savings. L3(~1-3k) computed per session.
components.rationale: Decision 11. Cost lever. L1+2 serialization must be separate from L3 (prompt start for cache eligibility).

components.name: architecture.md
components.purpose: ~/.fleet/projects/<id>/architecture.md. Project knowledge in Layer 1. V1 hand-written; V2 auto-indexed.
components.rationale: V1 zero impl burden. V1 only: read + validate + inject. V2 adds generation.

components.name: CLAUDE.md Constraints (patch 5)
components.purpose: No main build/test in code P-items. Only cargo check. Phase P-items run build/test.
components.rationale: V1-critical. Prevents build cache contention. Must inject into Layer 1 system prompt.

components.name: Cargo Check Compensation (patch 6)
components.purpose: Auto-run single-crate cargo check when marking code P-item done. Fail→revert to Failed.
components.rationale: V1-critical. Compensates patch 5. Early error detection.

components.name: Acceptance Criteria Schema
components.purpose: Builds|TestsPass(cmd)|HumanReview|Custom(rule). Master validates each before mark-done.
components.rationale: V1-critical. Without this: completion fuzzy. Forbids proxy signals(§5.7 Acceptance Audit Protocol).

components.name: Acceptance Audit Protocol
components.purpose: 4-step judicial process: unpack→find evidence→forbid proxies→escalate. Master only.
components.rationale: Red line. Non-optional gate before mark-done.

components.name: Human Gate (patch 9)
components.purpose: P-item + task-level flags. Status WaitHumanGate. User answers AskUserQuestion→Master mark-done.
components.rationale: V1-critical. User mid-task gate without blocking scheduler.

components.name: Artifacts (patch 8)
components.purpose: P-item declares outputs (FileList|GitDiff|TestOutput|ManualNote). Worker tags output_summary.
components.rationale: V1-critical. Bounded summaries (50-200 tokens) prevent context explosion.

components.name: Skippable (patch 8)
components.purpose: P-item auto-skips: NoChangesIn(paths)→git diff, Custom(rule)→worker eval. Status=Skipped.
components.rationale: V1-critical. Avoids unnecessary work.

components.name: Touches Conflict Auto-detect
components.purpose: Planner UI button '✨ auto edges': scan all P-items, detect write-write, auto-inject topo edge
components.rationale: MVP (§8). Prevent concurrent writes to same file. Complements patch 3 fallback.

components.name: Touches Runtime Hook (patch 4)
components.purpose: Edit/Write tool detects undeclared file→SIGSTOP worker→append Master event (not fail directly)
components.rationale: V1-critical. Master handles: add touches+retry, reject, escalate.

components.name: Implicit Shared Files (patch 3)
components.purpose: Scheduler maintains fallback list (FE=App.tsx/Layout/locales/; BE=mod.rs/lib.rs). Auto-inject edges.
components.rationale: V1-critical. Catches planner omissions. Dual approach: skill examples + scheduler fallback.

components.name: Sidebar UX
components.purpose: Task-primary, project-folded, filters. Shows active/done, progress bars.
components.rationale: User entry point. Lite mode reusable.

components.name: Task Kanban
components.purpose: 3 columns (Inbox/Running/Done), P-item cards with status icons, merged output stream
components.rationale: Primary work surface. Real-time progress + agent visibility.

components.name: DAG Visualization
components.purpose: Graphviz/Mermaid render (V1 optional, V2 editor). Node color=status, edge=dep-complete.
components.rationale: V1 can defer(matrix sufficient); V2 adds. If quick Mermaid integration: worth it.

components.name: DAG Matrix Edit
components.purpose: V1 lightweight edit: rows=P-items, dropdown depends_on, inline touches
components.rationale: MVP pragmatism. Graph editor → V2. Matrix text-friendly.

components.name: Inbox Dialog
components.purpose: Drag file/paste text/screenshot→atomic-plan-tasks→plan preview+edit→launch. One flow.
components.rationale: Core goal(§2). Materials→plan→launch without project jumping.

components.name: Auto Phase Insertion
components.purpose: Hybrid: auto-detect Cargo.toml/package.json/playwright→inject phase P-items. fleet.yaml overrides.
components.rationale: Decision 7. Default auto, user-overridable. V1 must ship detection+schema generation+override loading.

components.name: fleet.yaml Config
components.purpose: Project-level: phases{cmd, resources}, resources{custom locks}. YAML load+validate.
components.rationale: V1 read+parse; defer editor UI to V2.

components.name: Master Event-Driven
components.purpose: append_user_message driven: [event] worker done/fail/scheduler/touches; [user] input. No polling.
components.rationale: Architectural efficiency. One event cycle per state change.

components.name: Master Tool Set
components.purpose: 7 bash subcommands: get-plan, get-dispatchable, dispatch, read-output, mark-done, mark-failed, update-plan
components.rationale: Master API. All 7 required. Both backends.

components.name: Failure Handling Tiers
components.purpose: Master auto-fix hierarchy: typo→fix plan, validation→let worker fix, stuck→ask user
components.rationale: Decision 10. Prevents UX spam. Master smartness.

components.name: Resource Lock Auto-release
components.purpose: P-item fail→resources free immediately. Master decides retry.
components.rationale: Deadlock prevention.

components.name: Master Lifecycle
components.purpose: Task start→Master born. Task end→Master destroyed. Alive in between (no sleep/restart).
components.rationale: Decision 13. Full context persistence.

components.name: Master SYSTEM Template Embed
components.purpose: Compile-time include_str!(...). Dev escape: FLEET_MASTER_SYSTEM_TEMPLATE_OVERRIDE=/tmp/...
components.rationale: Engineering constraint(§7). Enable rapid Master prompt iteration.

components.name: Task Branch
components.purpose: V1: single fleet/task-<id> branch checked out in master cwd. V2: worktree-per-item.
components.rationale: V1 MVP. Worktree defer to V2 (§8 V2 bullets, shipped in worktree-and-auto-merge PRD).

components.name: P-merge P-item
components.purpose: Explicit merge step: depends_on=[all code], resources=[git]. Planner auto-injects.
components.rationale: V1 merge strategy. Auto-insert by planner.

components.name: Worker Output Summary
components.purpose: Worker writes 50-200 word bounded summary tagged with artifact kind. Layer 3 injects to downstream.
components.rationale: Context control. Prevents transcript explosion.

components.name: Cache Observe Fields
components.purpose: Session metadata: cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens (validate L1+2 strategy)
components.rationale: Cost observability. Test: 3 workers→L1+2 creation only worker 1, reads on 2+3.

components.name: Progress Reporting
components.purpose: SSE+heartbeat extend: task_id, p_item_id, progress_pct, cache tokens. Timeout 60s→red card(not auto-fail)
components.rationale: User visibility.

components.name: Dual Backend Support
components.purpose: Architecture constraint: every tool exists in both LocalBackend(direct core) + RemoteBackend(HTTP)
components.rationale: Non-negotiable(§7). All 7 tools need 2 impls.

components.name: HTTP Endpoints
components.purpose: fleet serve exposes /task API. POST/GET /task, /task/:id/plan, /task/:id/dispatch, etc.
components.rationale: RemoteBackend foundation.

components.name: Task State Mutex
components.purpose: V1: in-memory mutex per task_id. V2: SQLite+WAL for cross-process.
components.rationale: Concurrency safety.

components.name: Patch 2: P-item Granularity
components.purpose: Doc + skill prompt: 50-300 line target. <50 merge, >300 split (phase exempt). Skill test verify.
components.rationale: Planner guidance. Skill system prompt injection.

components.name: Plan Evolution (patch 10)
components.purpose: User append requirement via AskUserQuestion→Master calls update-plan to add P-item. Master only executor.
components.rationale: V1(Master architecture). Avoids multi-agent race.

components.name: Bootstrap Phases
components.purpose: Phase 0=manual old system(V1 dev). Phase 1=V1 dogfood task(patch 1 Inbox). Phase 2=V2 worktree validate.
components.rationale: Implementation meta-req. Each phase has acceptance table(§13).
